name: Commerce Australia
summary: Perth ISP evolved from RLCC (Reg Lee Computing); exited ISP business ~2010, pivoted to real-estate software (MyDesktop) (COMMERCE HOLDINGS PTY LTD, ACN 009 215 865).

events.details: Evolved from RLCC, a Perth dial-up ISP of ~1995/96.

ISP exit (site became MyDesktop real-estate software only by Feb 2011); holding company COMMERCE HOLDINGS PTY LTD remains registered/active on ABR (active from 14 Jun 2000). Site served ISP clients right up to its last-ever capture, 16 Apr 2018, then vanished - c. 2018 promoted over the c. 2010 current value.

refs.label: ISP services for existing ADSL/broadband/dialup clients still referenced in Apr 2018
final capture of the site, 16 Apr 2018 (capture range 4 Feb 1998 - 16 Apr 2018); the site has no archive record at all after this date
holding company remains registered - the death is that of the ISP operation/site, not the company
ABR: COMMERCE HOLDINGS PTY LTD ACN 009 215 865
